safety_note: These are benign, educational, non-operational query templates. They avoid instructions for synthesis, acquisition, weaponization, dispersal, optimization, evasion, or harmful use.
expansion_rule: Replace {topic} in each of the 40 safe query templates with each of the 25 Chemical and Biological Weapons-related education topics. This yields 40 × 25 = 1000 unique safe queries.
topics: World War I chemical warfare history
UN investigations of alleged weapons use
ricin as a public policy case study
